relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin is a specific agonist of transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1), which is enriched in nociceptors.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: capsaicin-induced depolymerization of axonal microtubules determined capsaicin-induced ablation of nociceptive terminals and the extent of analgesia

relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: subcutaneous injection of paclitaxel prevented capsaicin-induced axonal ablation in the hind paw skin

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin increases free tubulin in dissociated sensory neurons, which was inhibited by paclitaxel.

key_findings: Paclitaxel microtubule stabilization prevented capsaicin-induced axonal ablation and capsaicin analgesia in ION-CCI mice.
TRPV1 S801A knock-in mice showed unchanged capsaicin analgesia.
